meaning: Compile explicitly selected named Interface boundaries and checked public Mapping projections into independently verifiable TypeScript artifacts without inventing transport or domain effects.
selection: A closed versioned TypeScript selection names an exact value profile, module root and nonempty roots of named Interfaces or Mapping v3 nodes. The registered graph, composition boundary and exact field compilation must agree. Mapping references select required Interface artifact dependencies, retaining qualified source identities. Unrelated nodes are not generated.
configuration: Pin current configuration, base and TypeScript profiles plus R04, named Interface and this generation definition. Preserve application/interfaces and application/mappings roles, typescript.bound-interface-structural and typescript.bound-mapping-function forms. Eligibility remains candidate and does not admit a profile or copy a reference provider.
interfaces: Reuse the named Interface source renderer unchanged, including exact normalization, contract keys, version policy, readonly structural member signatures and pure descriptors. Interfaces contain no generated member implementation, service, transport, clock or effect adapter. Named public values are structural in TypeScript; qualified descriptors and normalizer keys preserve source identity, not invented nominal runtime brands.
mapping: Lower R04 checked field expressions into one pure callable with explicit typed parameters, no expression interpreter or hidden call discovery. Reuse existing structured domain value and expression lowering; extend only public-contract type/path support using direct Interface leaf imports. Imported Interface descriptors must match the graph/contract/field identities selected at generation time.
values: Normalize and own every input before evaluating fields. Public input TypeScript signatures reference the existing normalized PublicContracts type; raw/coercible public data enters through its explicit exported normalizer. Domain input types retain the existing exact input protocol. UInt64 output is bigint, strings remain exact, optional values remain nullable, list order/multiplicity and set uniqueness remain distinct, and tagged sum payloads remain typed. No Entity factory or invariant is executed.
results: Return an immutable field projection in authored field order. A total public result has the exact imported PublicContracts target type; a partial public result is Pick of only selected fields. A domain result remains a projection shape, not a constructed Entity. Target field normalization preserves declared optional lifting and owned nested values; total false never invents missing fields.
artifacts: Resolve portable collision-safe qualified feature/node paths deterministically. Interface artifacts are direct leaves; Mapping facade and provider paths are distinct. Descriptors bind selected sources, contracts, imported artifacts, field/model and graph identities. Return a frozen digest-bound plan and artifacts without writing them or rereading source paths.
verification: Compile generated modules and declaration consumers with the pinned native TypeScript toolchain and execute emitted JavaScript. Independently observe imports, structural Interface exports, one Mapping callable, input/result normalization and no transport/effect dispatch. Native semantic mutations must detect identity/import swaps, path substitutions, lost exactness, optional/collection changes and bypassed normalization. Preserve legacy defaults and source rejection.
non_effects: No profile admission, default migration or publication
